scope: Requested 15-author online and arXiv survey. Selected relevant papers and passages, not exhaustive publication lists or proof verification.

authors.name: Brian White
authors.result: New annuloids, Scherk and helicoid translators, high-genus expanders; updated pitchfork uniqueness. Existing flow-generated shrinkers retained.

authors.name: Tom Ilmanen
authors.result: Graphical translator classification and double-cone constructions already represented. Existing Ilmanen–White shrinkers retained; no duplicate family.

authors.name: Gerhard Huisken
authors.result: Ancient-oval entry now contrasts its type-II behavior with the uniform convex-pinching rigidity theorem.

authors.name: Sigurd Angenent
authors.result: New embedded eternal reaper chains and compact ancient spirals. Torus, paperclip, torus curves and neckpinches already represented.

authors.name: David Hoffman
authors.result: New translating and expanding examples; existing shrinkers and prescribed-end references retained.

authors.name: Francisco Martín
authors.result: Constructions plus current semigraphical uniqueness and entropy results.

authors.name: Felix Schulze
authors.result: Lagrangian translator classification screened; original Joyce–Lee–Tsui construction not audited, so no unsupported new family. Bowl stability, Clifford torus and expanding networks already present. Felix Schulze is distinct from Mario Schulz.

authors.name: Robert Haslhofer
authors.result: New ancient ovals with full dimensional parameter j and bowl-product tip limits.

authors.name: Niels Martin Møller
authors.result: New annuloid entropy and updated pitchfork classification use his joint work. Existing compact and one-ended shrinkers retained.

authors.name: Tobias Holck Colding
authors.result: Complexity and entropy papers screened; existing basic shrinkers and higher-codimension examples already cover the examples identified.

authors.name: William P. Minicozzi II
authors.result: Same joint-paper audit; no duplicate fundamental shrinker entry added.

authors.name: Lu Wang
authors.result: New mountain-pass expanders, with dimension and genericity restrictions. Distinct from Shengwen Wang and Xu-Jia Wang.

authors.name: Jacob Bernstein
authors.result: New mountain-pass construction; asymptotically conical hypotheses and unknown topology retained.

authors.name: Shengwen Wang
authors.result: New knotted expanders, including the genus-one, three-ended trefoil example.

authors.name: Alexander Mramor (Alex Mramor)
authors.result: New ancient minimal-surface perturbations, reapernoids, stacked pancakes and knotted expanders.
